mapper.insert: insert into goods(g_name, g_price, g_number, s_id, c3_name, g_imgNum, g_img1, g_img2, g_img3, g_img4, g_img5) values (#{name},#{price},#{number},#{shopID},#{class3},#{imgNumber},#{goodsImg1},#{goodsImg2},#{goodsImg3},#{goodsImg4},#{goodsImg5})
mapper.select: select g_id id, g_name name,g_sellNum sellNumber, g_price price, g_number number, c3_name class3, g_imgNum imgNumber, g_img1 goodsImg1, g_img2 goodsImg2, g_img3 goodsImg3, g_img4 goodsImg4, g_img5 goodsImg5 from goods,user,shop where user.u_phone = #{phone} AND user.id = shop.id AND goods.s_id = shop.s_id
